jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At Deliverect, our API-first platform is revolutionizing commerce by providing a connected suite of on and off-premise solutions. We empower both the food and retail industries to expand their revenue and simplify their operations, creating seamless experiences for businesses to sell anywhere and deliver everywhere. Join us in this exciting journey, where your contributions will directly impact how businesses connect with their customers in a rapidly evolving global market.


Department Focus:
The Marketing Department at Deliverect is a dynamic team of creative, data-driven, and results-oriented professionals dedicated to empowering businesses to deliver exceptional order experiences. By placing customers at the heart of our strategies and leveraging data to guide every decision, from campaign development to execution, we craft resonant marketing initiatives and continuously optimize our tactics. Collaboration is central to our approach, as we work seamlessly with other departments to align our efforts with overarching business goals. Committed to continuous growth and innovation, we strive to position Deliverect as an industry leader in marketing, redefining and elevating every interaction into a memorable journey
 
Your Impact:
As a Product Marketing Manager at Deliverect, you will play a critical role at the intersection of product development and marketing strategy. You will be the voice of our customers and partners, ensuring that the products we build are relevant and impactful. Your strategic insights and innovative marketing campaigns will drive product adoption and customer satisfaction, contributing significantly to Deliverect's ambitious growth mission. 
This is a full-time, fixed-term, hybrid role with a flexible work schedule, offering 3 days in our either our Amersfoort, Madrid, London or Ghent, Belgium offices and 2 days from the comfort of your home.

What you will do:
-
Plan and execute Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies for product & feature launches: From the inception of new products and features, you will take insights from the product team and act as the crucial link, ensuring information is digestible for both customers and GTM teams. This means creating a coherent narrative, compelling product positioning and messaging frameworks that communicate the value we create for customers by speaking directly to their needs, and creating the enablement tools and materials (battle cards, one pagers, etc) that provide the information required for GTM to accelerate deal success and closing opportunities. You will work closely with the product, marketing, and PR teams to ensure all materials are ready for successful launches including internal training. .

-
Track and analyze product marketing & campaign metrics such as user engagement and product adoption rates: You will assess the effectiveness of marketing strategies by monitoring key performance indicators that should inform the development of additional inside the product strategies to foster adoption, as well as inform the external marketing strategies.

-
Act as a crucial feedback loop between the market and product development: In collaboration and to support the product managers, you will gather actionable insights from sales, customer success, and market research to inform future product improvements and new features, ensuring continuous product enhancement. You will also utilise online resources, AI tools and benchmarking to perform direct comparisons between our products and competitors.
What you will bring:
-
5+ years of experience as a Product Marketing Manager or in a similar role in the business-to-business SaaS industry.

-
Strong understanding of B2B marketing principles and product-led growth

-
Ability to develop compelling product positioning and messaging.

-
Proficiency in marketing automation tools and analytics platforms.

-
Strong analytical skills to translate data into actionable insights.

-
Excellent project management skills to juggle multiple campaigns and deadlines.

-
Proven ability to work independently and take ownership of projects.

-
Collaborative spirit and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams (Sales, Product Development, etc.).

-
Strong communication skills to gather feedback and persuasively present insights to align on strategy.

-
Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.

-
Ability to develop engaging marketing campaigns and assets.

-
Comfortable using data to inform decisions and measure the success of marketing initiatives

Nice to have:

-
An understanding of the food service industry is a plus.

-
Passion for B2B SaaS: Enjoys promoting complex solutions to businesses.

-
Master’s degree in Marketing/business or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

-
Proficiency in more than 2 languages is a plus.
Join Our Innovative Journey:

At Deliverect, we're not just building a platform; we're redefining how restaurants and retailers connect with their customers globally. We're looking for agile, ambitious, and resourceful team members who are excited to tackle complex challenges, take calculated risks and contribute to innovative solutions that shape the future of commerce.

What You'll Gain by Joining Us:

Invest in Your Growth- We provide a dedicated learning budget to help you expand your skills and knowledge in this dynamic environment.
Solve Meaningful Challenges- Contribute to tackling some of the most significant challenges in the global tech industry, directly impacting the way businesses operate worldwide.
Drive Innovation- Immerse yourself in a culture where innovation isn't just a buzzword – our weekly releases and new features ensure you're always working on cutting-edge solutions.
Collaborate with a Global Team- Be part of a diverse, international team that values transparency, visibility, and a multitude of perspectives.
Be Part of a Unicorn- Join a rapidly scaling SaaS unicorn at the forefront of the order management industry, where your contributions have significant impact.
Enjoy Regionally Tailored Rewards- Our compensation and benefits packages are thoughtfully designed to reflect the unique needs of each market, ensuring you’re supported with what matters most—right where you are.

Our Commitment to Inclusion:

We are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and has equal opportunities to succeed. We strongly encourage applications from underrepresented groups.

Important Information:

1. Fluency in English is required, with strong written and verbal communication skills being essential. 
2. Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the role is based, as we are currently unable to provide financial assistance for relocation or travel.
3. Please note that certain roles may require a background check as a condition of employment, and you will be informed of this during the initial screening process.
4. We strive for an efficient and objective hiring process. Please be advised that an Artificial Intelligence tool is utilized to assist in the initial screening and assessment of applications based on required skills and qualifications. This process is designed to support our recruiters and does not replace human review.


If you require any accommodations or support during the recruitment process due to a disability, please do not hesitate to contact us at talent@deliverect.com.

Ready to shape the future of commerce with us? Explore our opportunities and apply today!

jobs.description:

We empower both the food and retail industries to expand their revenue and simplify their operations, creating seamless experiences for businesses to sell anywhere and deliver everywhere. Department Focus
The Product Department at Deliverect is at the forefront of the digital ordering revolution, dedicated to consistently delivering groundbreaking solutions to the global marketplace. Our team of passionate and innovative engineers, designers, and product managers architect tools that empower businesses to thrive in the evolving digital landscape, streamlining digital ordering for delivery and on-premise services. We are committed to creating user-friendly, dependable, and scalable technology that simplifies operations and enhances customer experiences, playing an integral role in the success of businesses worldwide. In our department, innovation is not just a concept; it's the driving force behind everything we do.
Your Impact
As a Senior Product Manager at Deliverect, you will play a critical role in shaping our product portfolio by leading the development and execution of impactful SaaS product strategies. Based in our Amersfoort, NL or Ghent, Belgium office, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of critical product initiatives, leveraging Product Led Growth (PLG) strategies to drive self-serve adoption and user retention. Your ability to balance technical complexity with a customer-centric approach will directly impact company revenue, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction across the global marketplace.
*This is a full-time, hybrid role with a flexible work schedule, offering 3 days in our Amersfoort or Ghent office and 2 days from the comfort of your home.

What you will do
-
Lead Product Strategy & Roadmap Development:  Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation to launch, developing detailed business cases and roadmaps aligned with Deliverect’s growth objectives .

-
Drive Product Led Growth (PLG) Initiatives : Architect and optimize self-serve onboarding funnels, in-product upgrade paths, and usage-driven tier models to drive user expansion and maximize platform value .

-
Cross-Functional Execution & Technical Collaboration :  Partner closely with engineering, architecture, and design teams to build scalable solutions, including managing technical requirements for APIs and core platform integrations .

-
Stakeholder Management & Alignment:  Act as a primary communicator to present clear product updates, pitch business cases, and influence alignment across all internal departments and external partners .

-
Data & Market Analysis: Define and track product KPIs, continuously leveraging analytics and customer insights to prioritize the product backlog and resolve complex user friction points .
What you will Bring
-
Product Management Expertise: 5+ years of experience managing SaaS products within an agile environment, preferably in the food tech, SaaS, foodservice, or hospitality sectors .

-
PLG Growth Mindset: Proven experience developing and optimizing self-serve user funnels, upgrade paths, or usage-driven monetization tiers .

-
Domain Knowledge: Deep familiarity with campaign management systems, online ordering networks, POS integrations, or technical API-first software architectures .

-
Data-Driven & Analytical Skills: Strong track record of tracking product KPIs, building data-backed business cases, and making high-impact prioritization decisions .

-
Collaborative Leadership: Demonstrated success leading cross-functional squads and complex projects through influence, clear communication, and empathetic stakeholder negotiation .

-
Education: A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience .

In addition, you will be leveraging Product-Led Growth (PLG) strategies to drive self-serve adoption of features and user retention. Your ability to balance technical complexity with a customer-centric approach will directly impact company revenue, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction across the global marketplace.


This is a full-time, hybrid role with a flexible work schedule, offering 3 days in our Paris offfice and 2 days from the comfort of your home.

What you will do
- Unlock New Markets Alongside GTM: Act as the product counterpart to our GTM teams on market expansion. You will run detailed assessments of each target market to pinpoint the capability gaps and opportunities that decide whether we win there — local POS and delivery-platform integrations, payment methods, localization, and regulatory or fiscal requirements — and translate those findings into clearly specified, prioritized product requirements with a defensible case for sequencing.

- Lead Product Strategy & Roadmap Development: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation to launch, developing detailed business cases and roadmaps aligned with Deliverect's growth objectives.

- Own Successful Market Rollout: Partner closely with GTM, Sales, and Onboarding to make sure each new-market launch actually lands. You will define launch readiness criteria, equip commercial and implementation teams with what they need to sell and deploy the product locally, and close the loop on early market feedback so that the second and third customers in a market are meaningfully easier to win than the first.

- Drive Product Led Growth (PLG) Initiatives: Architect and optimize self-serve onboarding funnels, in-product upgrade paths, and usage-driven tier models to drive user expansion and maximize platform value.

- Cross-Functional Execution & Technical Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, architecture, and design teams to build scalable solutions, including managing technical requirements for APIs and core platform integrations.

- Stakeholder Management & Alignment: Act as a primary communicator to present clear product updates, pitch business cases, and influence alignment across all internal departments and external partners.

- Data, Market & Competitive Analysis: Define and track product KPIs, and continuously leverage analytics, competitive intelligence, and customer insights — at both product and individual market level — to prioritize the backlog and resolve complex user friction points.
What you will Bring
- Product Management Expertise: 5+ years of experience managing SaaS products within an agile environment, preferably in the food tech, SaaS, foodservice, or hospitality sectors.

- Market Expansion Experience: A track record of taking a product into new geographies or segments — assessing local requirements, competitive gaps, and compliance needs, then shipping the changes required to compete there. Direct experience with localization, regional integrations, or multi-market rollouts is a strong advantage.

- PLG Growth Mindset: Proven experience developing and optimizing self-serve user funnels, upgrade paths, or usage-driven monetization tiers.

- Domain Knowledge: Deep familiarity with campaign management systems, online ordering networks, POS integrations, or technical API-first software architectures.

- Data-Driven & Analytical Skills: Strong track record of tracking product KPIs, building data-backed business cases, and making high-impact prioritization decisions.

- Collaborative Leadership: Demonstrated success leading cross-functional squads and complex projects through influence, clear communication, and empathetic stakeholder negotiation — including working effectively with commercial and regional teams across time zones.

- Education: A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
